Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class ReleaseInventoryPhaseGeometry

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.ReleaseInventoryPhaseGeometry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ReleaseInventoryPhaseGeometry extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable cylindrical-vessel geometry for fail-closed phase-selected inventory withdrawal.

The model supports one equilibrium gas phase above at most one equilibrium liquid phase. It calculates liquid level and gas/liquid interfacial area directly from the live phase volumes. The opening elevation is then compared with the interface and a caller-declared exclusion band. An opening inside that band is rejected because entrainment, waves and interface crossing are unresolved. This class does not predict carry-over, slip, level control or finite-rate phase transfer.
